page.content:
Stretchy magical dog and Finn's brother.

How Jake the Dog connects

  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — Jake is Finn's brother through the original series.
  • Faction: Heroes of Ooo — Jake adventures with Finn as brother and partner.
  • Character: Finn the Human — Finn and Jake are brothers who adventure together.

What is Jake the Dog?

Jake the Dog is the stretchy older brother who treats adventure as a hang, plays viola, and still shows up when Finn's heroism gets heavy.

Key threads lead to Adventure Time (series), Heroes of Ooo and Finn the Human.
